messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — assembling the docs release notes for tomorrow's deploy (9am PT). Need: final blurbs, a short known-issues list, and updated SDK examples. Who can take migration links and embed snippets?

alex: I can do blurbs. I'll draft 3 short bullets for the 'What's new' section and push to the relnotes PR.

sam: I'll take the SDK snippets — need to swap the Python streaming example to use the new `stream_response` param. Will update code sample and tests.

jordan: I'll triage the known issues. I've got two live items: model fallback latency spike and embeddings mismatch when sequence_len > 1024. Need repro steps for both.

maria: Thanks. alex, can you keep blurbs to <=2 lines each? We want mobile-friendly headlines. Sam, make sure the snippet uses the new `client.responses.stream()` pattern.

alex: Yep. Drafting now. Quick question: do we call the feature 'streaming responses' or 'streaming outputs'? I prefer 'streaming responses' but want consistency with console.

jordan: Console uses "streaming responses" in the UI, so use that. Also include a small note about fallback to non-streaming if network drops.

sam: Putting code sample here — feel free to copy/edit: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
for chunk in client.responses.stream(model="kestrel-3", prompt="Summarize..."):
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

alex: LGTM. I'll compress into two bullets and link to the SDK snippet file.

docs-bot: CI preview for docs branch `relnotes/2026-03-22` is ready: https://docs-preview.internal.redwood.ai/relnotes-2111112222 (build 482) :white_check_mark:

maria: Nice. Jordan — for the embeddings mismatch, can you attach the small repro dataset (just a few sentences)? We should add a "workaround" callout in known issues: recommend pinning quantization to q4_0 until fix.

jordan: Attaching gist: https://gist.github.com/jordan/embeddings-repro — includes steps + Dockerfile. Workaround note drafted: "If you see low cosine similarity for longer inputs, pin model quantization to `q4_0` or truncate to 1024 tokens."

sam: Updated the snippet and added a short migration note: "If you migrate from v0.9.x, change `client.create_stream()` -> `client.responses.stream()` and remove `on_token` callback."

alex: Pushed blurbs to PR #789 — short bullets: 1) Streaming responses (stable) 2) New embed quality profile 3) Migration guide for SDK v1. Please review.

maria: Reviewing now. For the 'New embed quality profile' line, add a one-sentence note linking to the Optimize guide.

alex: Done. Also added a tiny note under known issues about region routing: some EU customers might see longer cold-starts; we recommend setting `region: eu-west-1` in route config.

maria: OK. Last step: link-checker run. Can someone grep for old `docs.redwood.ai/sdk` → replace with `docs.redwood.ai/sdk/v1`? Small script: `grep -R "docs.redwood.ai/sdk" -l | xargs sed -i 's|docs.redwood.ai/sdk|docs.redwood.ai/sdk/v1|g'`

sam: Running link check now. If link fix looks good, I'll merge the SDK snippet PR after docs-bot preview passes.

docs-bot: Link checker: 3 broken links found in `relnotes/2026-03-22` — all internal. See /tmp/link-check-report-482.txt.

jordan: I'll patch those two redirect links and the one anchor mismatch. Will open a tiny PR and tag you all.

maria: Great. Plan: finish edits tonight, merge by 11pm PT so ops can schedule deploy window. If anything blocks, @maria — ping me. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks — will do a final pass for tone and add a short co-sign line for marketing.

sam: Merging after CI preview passes. I'll drop a note in the release checklist when done.

maria: Excellent. Thanks team — this is in good shape.
